issues.title: Concurrency/Race Condition in ZIP Finalization
issues.why: The spec identifies a critical race condition in Go's zip writer (ZIP-FINALIZE-001) but provides a code snippet that manually manages file handles without a robust 'must-cleanup' pattern for all failure branches.
issues.fix: Provide a standardized Go 'SafeZip' wrapper or a definitive try/finally-equivalent pattern that guarantees handle closure and disk cleanup on all error paths.

issues.title: Incomplete Acceptance Test Coverage for Sub-modules
issues.why: The root overview (spec/03/00-overview.md) relies on AC-08/AC-09 to 'pin' sub-modules, but the actual behavioral ACs for Error Resolution and Verification Patterns are truncated or missing from the provided context.
issues.fix: Ensure every sub-module overview contains a complete GWT table for its specific domain logic (e.g., specific retry backoff values).

issues.title: Dangling References to Downstream Repos
issues.why: The spec acknowledges 'drift' (Phase 27) where ACs reference files in non-existent 'downstream repos' (e.g., backend/internal/api/handlers/handlers.go).
issues.fix: Explicitly define these as 'Interface Contracts' that the downstream repo MUST implement, rather than referencing them as existing local files.
